lines.text: The whole town went black. And Nora gave Theo one chance.
lines.sub: The whole town went black. And Nora gave Theo one chance.

lines.text: Three weeks ago, I got the same message. Then a second one. Only for me.
lines.sub: “Three weeks ago, I got the same message. Then a second one. Only for me.”

lines.text: If Nora goes to the tower, she doesn't come back.
lines.sub: “If Nora goes to the tower… she doesn't come back.”

lines.text: And you just didn't tell me?
I thought if you never knew, you'd never go.
lines.sub: “I thought if you never knew… you'd never go.”

lines.text: But the radio had just told her to go. Alone.
lines.sub: But the radio had just told her to go. Alone.

lines.text: The boy in my drawing. His phone always says eleven forty seven.
lines.sub: “The boy in my drawing… his phone always says 11:47.”

lines.text: Only one building in Harlow Point still had power. The sheriff's station.
lines.sub: Only one building in Harlow Point still had power. The sheriff's station.

lines.text: Then Nora's phone buzzed. A text from Theo.
lines.sub: Then Nora's phone buzzed. A text… from Theo.

lines.text: Nora, it's me. I'm outside. Don't trust whoever is with you.
lines.sub: “Nora, it's me. I'm outside. Don't trust whoever is with you.”

lines.text: Down in the yard stood Theo. Dry, in the pouring rain. His phone glowing. Eleven forty seven.
lines.sub: Down in the yard stood Theo. Dry… in the pouring rain. His phone glowing: 11:47.

lines.text: What should we do next? Comment one or two below, and tell me why!
lines.sub: What should we do next? Comment 1 or 2 below and tell me why!

lines.text: Follow so you don't miss what happens next!
